color: rgb(74, 47, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
the tension
an agent frees up while the customer is
mid-sentence describing their problem

div.style: color: rgb(92, 26, 19) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
option A: wait for them to finish
the agent sits idle, the customer waits longer.
We have made the call centre SLOWER using AI.
Indefensible.

div.style: color: rgb(92, 26, 19) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
option B: cut them off instantly
we get a fragment, and the customer feels
interrupted by a machine.

div.style: color: rgb(8, 54, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

p.b: D21: the OFFER WINDOW is the grace period

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 69) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: the agent gets the offer card immediately

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 69) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
those ~7 seconds while they read who and why
are seconds the customer can still be talking

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 69) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
intake finalises as partial - a cut-off
sentence is still useful evidence

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 69) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
the insight: the grace period was already there.
We did not add delay - we noticed that the time an
agent spends reading the brief is dead time for the
customer, and gave it a job. Nobody waits longer.

div.style: color: rgb(74, 56, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
and the hard rule it protects (D12):
the call is NEVER blocked on AI. If intake is slow,
down, or unsure, it degrades to a lesser brief.
It never delays the human connection.
